_quarry.citation: Morgan, David. The Mongols. 2nd ed. Oxford: Blackwell Publishing, 2007.
_quarry.notes: Standard one-volume English-language survey of the Mongol empire and successor khanates. First edition 1986; second edition adds chapters reflecting post-1986 scholarship. Used for Genghis Khan, Kublai Khan, Mongol Empire entity, Ilkhanate, Chagatai, and Yuan records.
